string.text: Master switch for automatic safe-state Composure recovery.
Flat Composure restored per real second while every safety condition is satisfied. Default 0.020, equal to 1.2 points per minute.
Automatic recovery stops at this Composure value. Default 65.
Seconds of uninterrupted safety required after combat, damage, firing, a recovery lock, loading, or changing levels.
Stops recovery while Combat or another module reports that recovery is unsafe. The full safety delay begins after the lock clears.
Prevents passive recovery from automatically reviving the actor from zero Composure.
Uses GAMMA's actor-combat targeting table to stop recovery when nearby humans or mutants are actively fighting the actor.
Maximum distance in metres at which an actor-targeting enemy blocks recovery. Default 100.
Minimum number of seconds combat remains unsafe after the last actively targeting enemy disappears.
Any actor hit removes the recovery source and restarts the safety delay.
Firing the actor's weapon removes the recovery source and restarts the safety delay.
Shows the current recovery state, safety-delay time, and detected combatants. Default F9.
Writes recovery state changes to the X-Ray log.
